stories.label: Iran crisis — Feb 26 Geneva talks Thursday
stories.summary: Feb 26 Geneva talks confirmed for Thursday. Iran vows 'ferocious' retaliation if struck. US evacuated Beirut staff, second carrier in Crete. Trump denies Pentagon opposes war. Not selected — 21 articles deep, only cover for talks outcome, military action, or deal framework.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — 10,000 troops deployed after El Mencho death
stories.summary: 70+ killed in raids and retaliation. 10,000 troops deployed. Violence continuing but no major new development beyond troop deployment. Not selected this cycle.

stories.label: Israel advances death penalty bill targeting Palestinians
stories.summary: Knesset debating death penalty bill. First execution since Eichmann (1962) would be Palestinian. Still developing.

stories.label: Hong Kong 47: All appeals dismissed in largest NSL trial
stories.summary: All 12 appeals dismissed. Legal architecture for permanent political control established.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — 4th anniversary passed
stories.summary: 4th anniversary passed. Zelensky accuses Putin of starting WWIII. Putin prioritizes nuclear triad. Moscow railway station blast killed police officer. No concrete new development.

stories.label: 200+ Venezuelan political prisoners on hunger strike
stories.summary: 379 granted amnesty but military-charge detainees excluded. Venezuela now inviting exiles to return. Maduro release from US custody still demanded.

stories.label: Netherlands installs youngest PM Jetten
stories.summary: Rob Jetten becomes youngest Dutch PM. Minority government faces uphill task after Wilders coalition collapse.

stories.label: Zambian communities poisoned by Copperbelt mining boom
stories.summary: Green transition mining boom causing pollution in Copperbelt. Classic extraction pattern with new commodity.

stories.label: Pakistan warns 7.1M at risk from melting glaciers
stories.summary: Temperatures 3-5°C above normal. 13,000 glaciers, 10,000 receding. 7.1M people vulnerable. Above-normal temps forecast through April.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — FedEx sues for refunds, CBP stops collecting
stories.summary: FedEx files first major corporate lawsuit for tariff refunds after Supreme Court ruling. CBP stopped collecting struck-down tariffs Feb 24. Trump threatens 'much higher' new tariffs. Democrats push refund bill. Three contradictory US positions still active.

stories.label: Sudan war — humanitarian crisis deepening
stories.summary: Chad border still closed. Museveni's son compared RSF to Hitler days after his father hosted Dagalo. Needs dedicated internal humanitarian angle when fresh data emerges.

stories.label: Israel designates 5 Palestinian news outlets as terrorist groups
stories.summary: 5 Palestinian news orgs designated terrorist groups. Criminalizes consuming, sharing, or working for outlets. Enforcement in occupied East Jerusalem.

stories.label: ICC confirmation hearing against Duterte for drug war killings
stories.summary: ICC prosecutors say Duterte was 'pivotal' in murder of thousands. First SE Asian head of state at ICC. Drug war killed 12,000-30,000.

stories.label: AI tools can now design entire genomes from scratch
stories.summary: AI systems architecting whole organisms. Biosecurity governance gap widening as capability outpaces regulation.

stories.label: Meta AI Safety Director's agent deletes her inbox
stories.summary: Meta alignment director's inbox deleted by AI agent she was testing. Illustrates agent safety problem.

stories.label: US withdraws from NE Syria, abandoning Kurdish allies
stories.summary: US pulling out of NE Syria. Full withdrawal within a month. Turkey repatriating ISIS fighters. Kurdish SDF losing last external backer.

stories.label: Panama takes control of canal ports from Hong Kong firm
stories.summary: Supreme Court declared CK Hutchison concession unconstitutional. Government ordered occupation of Balboa and Cristobal terminals.

stories.label: France restricts US Ambassador Kushner after he ignores summons
stories.summary: France stripped Ambassador Kushner of direct ministerial access. France moving to block him from government access entirely. NATO ally downgrading US ambassador is extraordinary.

stories.label: Binance fired employees who found $1.7B sent to Iran
stories.summary: NYT reports compliance employees discovered $1.7B in crypto routed to Iran and were fired. Already paid $4.3B fine in 2023.

stories.label: Billion years missing from Earth's history — Great Unconformity solved
stories.summary: Columbia research resolves 150-year geological mystery. Shifting continents, not snowball Earths, erased a billion years of rock.

stories.label: ASML EUV breakthrough could yield 50% more chips by 2030
stories.summary: ASML unveils new EUV light source technology. 50% more chips from same equipment by 2030.

stories.label: African gig workers unknowingly trained US military AI
stories.summary: Rest of World investigation. Data labelers in Africa unknowingly worked on US military contracts through layers of subcontracting.

stories.label: Settlers kill Palestinian teen while Israeli soldiers watched
stories.summary: Settlers attacked Mukhmas, shot three, killed a teenager. Israeli soldiers stood by smoking 'as if nothing was happening.' Military complicity through deliberate inaction.

stories.label: China hits 40 Japanese firms with export curbs over military ties
stories.summary: China sanctioned 40 Japanese entities including Mitsubishi Heavy Industries subsidiaries. 20 on export control list, 20 on watch list. Retaliation for Japan joining US chip export controls.

stories.label: IBM posts worst day in 25 years after AI threatens COBOL moat
stories.summary: IBM suffered steepest stock drop since 2000 after Anthropic showed AI can modernize COBOL — the 65-year-old language running 95% of ATM transactions. AI threatens IBM's legacy modernization monopoly.

stories.label: Deadly floods sweep Peru — 700+ districts in emergency
stories.summary: 700+ districts declared emergency as torrential rains trigger mudslides and flooding across Peru. Over a third of municipalities affected. La Niña-driven climate event.

stories.label: Kim Yo-jong promoted at rare North Korea party congress
stories.summary: Kim Yo-jong promoted from deputy to full department director at Workers' Party congress — first in 5 years. Formalizes her already extensive informal power. Succession signal.

stories.label: Brazil reverses Amazon port expansion after Indigenous protests
stories.summary: Government revoked Amazon port expansion order after Indigenous communities mobilized. Win for environmental protection, but soy industry just abandoned deforestation moratorium — pressure on the forest continues.

stories.label: Israeli forces detain 100+ Palestinians in Ramadan
stories.summary: 100+ detained since Ramadan began. Al-Aqsa access blocked. 9,300 currently held. Subsumed by broader settler violence pattern.
